_comment: Vendor contract tracker for Northbridge Health Network. Tracks all active vendor contracts with SLA, commercial terms, renewal dates, and compliance requirements. Used by the VMO (vendor_manager persona) and operations leadership. Supports the Weekly Vendor & Commitment Status and Joint Commission Readiness Report agent-initiated automations.

vendor_contract_tracker.service_credit_clause: MSA clause 7.4 — 8% of implementation fee per week of Lumina-side go-live delay
vendor_contract_tracker.performance_kpi: Go-live on schedule, post-go-live incident count < 5/month, training completion ≥ 95%

vendor_contract_tracker.service_credit_clause: 10% of monthly fee per calendar month with SLA breach
vendor_contract_tracker.performance_kpi: Calibration completion rate ≥ 98%, certificate turnaround ≤ 48h, zero missed Joint Commission equipment items

vendor_contract_tracker.service_credit_clause: Clause 5.2 — 5% of delayed line-item value per week of delay
vendor_contract_tracker.performance_kpi: On-time delivery rate ≥ 95%, formulary-kit fill rate ≥ 99%, controlled-substance compliance 100%
vendor_contract_tracker.next_milestone: Controlled-substance audit log binder delivery 16-JUL-2026 (delayed from 11-JUL)

vendor_contract_tracker.service_credit_clause: 5% of monthly license fee per month with uptime below 99.5%
vendor_contract_tracker.performance_kpi: Uptime ≥ 99.5%, P1 response ≤ 2h, upgrade deployment on schedule
